title: Midnighter #7 Wildstorm July 2007 Brian K Vaughan Darick Robertson Chris Sprouse
condition_description: Light scuffing and a few small spots on the front cover near the barcode (close-up pictured); light corner wear. Spine and staples intact.
description:
Midnighter #7 (July 2007), Wildstorm / DC Comics. Written by Brian K. Vaughan (Y: The Last Man, Saga), art by Darick Robertson, cover by Chris Sprouse and Karl Story. Direct sales edition, $2.99 cover price.

Condition: light scuffing and a few small spots near the barcode (see close-up), light corner wear. The "CS KS" on the cover is the printed artist signature.

Back cover: Crackdown (Xbox 360) ad.

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
